datum: For ye are bought with a great price. * Glorify God, and bear Him in your body.

incipit: I cried with my whole heart

datum: V. Cleanse Thou me from secret faults, O Lord.
R. Preserve Thy servant also from the sins of others.
Look Thou upon me, * O Lord, and be merciful unto me.

versus: For my foot standeth in uprightness.

datum: Her time is near to come, + and her days shall not be prolonged. * For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and Israël shall be saved.

versus: And His glory shall be seen upon thee.

dominica: V. O Lord God of powers convert us.
R. And show us Thy face, and we shall be safe.
feria: V. Come, O Lord, and make no tarrying.
R. Pardon the sins of Thy people.

datum: By the armour of righteousness * let us approve ourselves in much patience, by the power of God.
Deal thy bread to the hungry, and bring the poor that are cast out to thine house: + when thou seest the naked, cover him, * and hide not thyself from thine own flesh.

versus: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night.

datum: V. God hath given His angels charge over thee.
R. To keep thee in all thy ways.
Did not they reward me * evil for good? for they digged a pit for my soul.
Remember that I stood before Thee, + to speak good for them, * and to turn away Thy wrath from them.

incipit: Make not to perish with sinners
versus: Nor my life with bloody men.

datum: V. Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man.
R. Preserve me from the wicked man.
Christ hath once suffered for our sins, the Just for the unjust, + that He might bring us to God,being put to death in the flesh,* but quickened by the Spirit.
V. Abide with us, Lord, Alleluia.
R. For it is toward evening, Alleluia.
